## Setup

First, we load the required packages and prepare a small dataset in R.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(ggplot2)

# Create an in-memory DuckDB and register a data frame
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb("./database.db"))
```

## The Analysis

The listing answer the following questions:

Of donations made, how many were made each day, and how much was donated each day?

@lst-time-series-donations


Which candidate has recieved the most donations from each state?

@lst-ranked-state-donation


Of donations made by committeees to candidates, for each interest group type, for those applicable, what percentage of money went to democrats?

@lst-committee-to-candidate-committee

What committee donated the most to afton byne, (do the same for specifically leadership pacs)

@lst-highest-rank-pac-for-bahn

What is the mean, median, mode, and varience of contributions from individuals?

@lst-mean-median-mode-individual


#### Time Series Donations
::: {#lst-time-series-donations}


```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| code-fold: true

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mart.time_series_donations;

CREATE TABLE mart.time_series_donations AS
SELECT
  donations.transaction_date,
  committee.committee_name,
  sum(donations.transaction_amount) AS amount
FROM
  mart.donations AS donations
  LEFT JOIN mart.committee AS committee
    ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
    ON committee.internal_id = cc_linkage.committee_key
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
    ON cc_linkage.candidate_key = candidate.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.contributors AS contributors
    ON donations.contributor_key = contributors.internal_id
WHERE
  (
    candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%behn%'
    OR candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
    OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%unrigged%'
    OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
  )
  AND (
    donations.transaction_date BETWEEN (
      '2025-12-02'::DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    ) AND '2025-12-02'::DATE
  )
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  amount desc;


```


```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| echo: false
--| max.print: -1

select * from mart.time_series_donations;
 
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Aggregate USD amount by week"
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart showing daily USD expenditures for Epps vs Behn "

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "
                PIVOT mart.time_series_donations
                ON committee_name
                USING first(amount)
                ORDER by transaction_date desc
")

# Most basic bubble plot
p <- ggplot(
  data = subset(result, !is.na(`MATT VAN EPPS FOR CONGRESS`)),
  aes(x = transaction_date)
) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .data[['MATT VAN EPPS FOR CONGRESS']],
                color = 'MATT VAN EPPS FOR CONGRESS')) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .data[['UNRIGGED PAC']],
                color = 'UNRIGGED PAC')) +
  labs(y = "Amount (USD)")
p
```

**Listing:** A SQL query that aggregates the amount of USD spent in the Epps vs Behn race for the week of 2025-12-02 order by greatest to least transaction , along with its resulting time series chart.


:::






#### State Donations
::: {#lst-ranked-state-donation}


```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| code-fold: true

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mart.ranked_states;

CREATE TABLE mart.ranked_states AS
WITH ranking AS (
  SELECT
    contributors.state,
    committee.committee_name,
    sum(donations.transaction_amount) AS amountUSD,
    count(*) AS donations_count
  FROM
    mart.donations AS donations
    LEFT JOIN mart.committee AS committee
      ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
    LEFT JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
      ON committee.internal_id = cc_linkage.committee_key
    LEFT JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
      ON cc_linkage.candidate_key = candidate.internal_id
    LEFT JOIN mart.contributors AS contributors
      ON donations.contributor_key = contributors.internal_id
  WHERE
    (
      candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%behn%'
      OR candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
      OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%unrigged%'
    )
    AND (
      donations.transaction_date
      BETWEEN ('2025-12-02'::DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND '2025-12-02'::DATE
    )
  GROUP BY
    ALL
)

SELECT
  *,
  dense_rank()
    OVER (PARTITION BY committee_name ORDER BY amountUSD DESC)
    AS amountUSD_rank,
  dense_rank()
    OVER (PARTITION BY committee_name ORDER BY donations_count DESC)
    AS donations_count_rank
FROM
  ranking
ORDER BY
  amountUSD_rank;

```

```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| echo: false
--| max.print: -1
--| fig-cap: "percentages of USD going to parties"
select * from mart.ranked_states
order by amountUSD desc
limit 15;

```


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Aggregate USD amount by State"
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart showing daily USD expenditures for Epps vs Behn "

result <- dbGetQuery(con, "
           from mart.ranked_states
           where 
           amountUSD_rank <= 15
           order by state;
        ")

# Most basic bubble plot
ggplot(result, aes(fill=.data[['committee_name']],x=reorder(.data[['state']], -.data[['amountUSD']]), y=.data[['amountUSD']])) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip()

```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Aggregate donation count by State"
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart showing daily USD donation count for Epps vs Behn "


ggplot(result, aes(fill=.data[['committee_name']],x=reorder(.data[['state']], -.data[['donations_count']]), y=.data[['donations_count']])) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip()

```


A SQL query that aggregates the amount of USD spent in the Epps vs Behn race by state ranked donations , along with its resulting bar chart.

::: 

#### Pacs for aften Bahn
::: {#lst-highest-rank-pac-for-bahn}


```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| code-fold: true

SELECT
  donations.transaction_type,
  contributors.contributor_lender_name,
  sum(donations.transaction_amount) AS amount
-- candidate.candidate_name,
-- contributors.contribution_type,
-- committee.committee_name
FROM
  mart.donations AS donations
  LEFT JOIN mart.committee AS committee
    ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
    ON committee.internal_id = cc_linkage.committee_key
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
    ON cc_linkage.candidate_key = candidate.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.contributors AS contributors
    ON donations.contributor_key = contributors.internal_id
WHERE
  (
    candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%aft%behn%'
    OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%unrigged%'
  )
  AND (
    donations.transaction_date BETWEEN (
      '2025-12-02'::DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    ) AND '2025-12-02'::DATE
  )
  AND contributors.contribution_type ILIKE 'one committee to another'
--      AND contributors.contributor_lender_name
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  amount DESC;

```


a simple table that looks at the most enthusiastic committee for bahn

#### Committee to Candidate Committee
::: {#lst-committee-to-candidate-committee}


```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| code-fold: true
--| max.print: -1

WITH committee_dollars AS (
  SELECT
    committee.committee_party,
    sum(donations.transaction_amount) AS dollars_sum,
    count(donations.transaction_amount) AS count
  FROM
    mart.donations AS donations
    LEFT JOIN mart.committee AS committee
      ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
    LEFT JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
      ON committee.internal_id = cc_linkage.committee_key
    LEFT JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
      ON cc_linkage.candidate_key = candidate.internal_id
    LEFT JOIN mart.contributors AS contributors
      ON donations.contributor_key = contributors.internal_id
  WHERE
    (
      candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%behn%'
      OR candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
      OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%unrigged%'
    )
    -- AND (donations.transaction_date BETWEEN ('2025-12-02'::DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    -- AND '2025-12-02'::DATE)
    AND (
      contributors.contribution_type = 'commitee to candidate'
      OR contributors.contribution_type = 'one committee to another'
    )
  GROUP BY ALL
  ORDER BY dollars_sum DESC
),

running_total AS (
  SELECT
    dollars_sum,
    committee_party,
    sum(dollars_sum) OVER (
      ORDER BY committee_party RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
      AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS t2
  FROM committee_dollars
)

SELECT
  (round(dollars_sum / t2, 2) * 100)::varchar || '%' AS Republican,
  (round(1 - dollars_sum / t2, 2) *100)::varchar || '%' AS Democrat
FROM running_total
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY Democrat desc
LIMIT 1
;



```

Show the percentage of the total amount of usd sent from committee to candidate committee
:::

#### mean median and mode of individuals
::: {#lst-mean-median-mode-individual}
```{sql}
--| connection: con
--| code-fold: true
--| max.print: -1

SELECT
  sum(donations.transaction_amount) AS dollars_sum,
  count(donations.transaction_amount) AS count,
  round(mean(donations.transaction_amount), 2) AS dollars_mean,
  median(donations.transaction_amount) AS dollars_median,
  mode(donations.transaction_amount) AS dollars_mode
FROM
  mart.donations AS donations
  LEFT JOIN mart.committee AS committee
    ON donations.committee_key = committee.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate_commitee_linkage AS cc_linkage
    ON committee.internal_id = cc_linkage.committee_key
  LEFT JOIN mart.candidate AS candidate
    ON cc_linkage.candidate_key = candidate.internal_id
  LEFT JOIN mart.contributors AS contributors
    ON donations.contributor_key = contributors.internal_id
WHERE
  (
    candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%behn%'
    OR candidate.candidate_name ILIKE '%van%epps%'
    OR committee.committee_name ILIKE '%unrigged%'
  )
  AND (
    donations.transaction_date BETWEEN ('2025-12-02'::DATE - INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    AND '2025-12-02'::DATE
  )
ORDER BY dollars_sum DESC;

```

This talbe shows the  mean median and mode for individual donors to candidates committee, only shows individuals who have donated more than once.
:::
